sections.briefing_title: AI 与大模型日报：Meta 开放权重模型登陆 Mac，开放权重用量与支出倒挂
sections.briefing_summary: 本期聚焦 AI 与大模型的多项动态：Meta 发布开放权重模型 Muse Spark Open，并与苹果合作使其可在 Apple silicon 本地运行；前沿研究方面，ARIA 面向多智能体系统进行运行时检查与修正，RoLaQ 为多头潜在注意力的 2 位 KV 缓存做联合校准，CoTS 以竞争性 token 选择支持潜在推理，EvolvingBrain 让多模态智能体在开放世界中自演化。产品侧，Rivian 计划在汽车中引入 AI 智能体，Vercel AI 网关 10 月生产指数显示开放权重模型占 71.5% 路由 token、但仅占 23% 支出，MeddeX 结合 LLaMA-3 与 Gemini Vision 分析医疗报告。治理与评估方面，Anthropic 允许 METR 研究员以员工级权限查看系统并放弃阻止发布评估的权利，另有论文讨论基准饱和后的模型能力评估、实时时钟下的智能体评测 RealtimeBench，以及面向视觉语言模型的选择性安全框架 CNRF。
sections.briefing_title_en: AI & LLMs Daily: Meta's Open-Weight Model Lands on Macs as Open Weights Dominate Tokens but Not Spend
sections.briefing_summary_en: This briefing covers AI and large-model developments: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an open-weight model built with Apple to run locally on Apple silicon. On the research side, ARIA performs runtime inspection and amendment for multi-agent systems, RoLaQ introduces joint calibration for 2-bit KV caches in multi-head latent attention, CoTS uses competitive token selection for latent reasoning, and EvolvingBrain enables multi-modal agents to self-evolve in open worlds. In products, Rivian plans to bring AI agents into its cars, while Vercel's October AI Gateway Production Index shows open-weight models took 71.5% of routed tokens but only 23% of spending; MeddeX combines LLaMA-3 with Gemini Vision for medical report analysis. On governance and evaluation, Anthropic is giving METR researchers employee-level access and waiving the right to block publication of assessments; papers also address evaluating capabilities after benchmark saturation, RealtimeBench for agents under a live clock, and CNRF for selective safety in vision-language models.
